privacy: Raw browser keys, domain/tool inventories, user paths and Trash responses remain in a private local report outside version control.
behavior: Move attribution from CLI into core; reuse bounded native layout discovery and classified traversal, with one parent/child accounting pass per subsystem.
Default macOS/Linux/Windows profiles, mirrored cache roots and selected installation model/component directories; exact browser/profile/domain filters.
Protobuf wire fields 2/3, not URL heuristics; preserve full keys, ports and partition suffixes. Legacy IndexedDB pairs and modern WebStorage IDs.

Read QuotaManager through a capped native-bound regular-file observation; deserialize into read-only in-memory SQLite, never open the live browser SQLite path through SQLite. No WAL/journal replay or atomic cross-file mapping claim.
Domain totals are display grouping, with concrete browser/profile/subsystem/key/bucket/path details. Shared databases/caches/models remain unattributed, not junk or execution authority.
Preserve result/v1 field names, decimal byte strings, independent sizeComplete/fullyAttributed, unknown nulls, explicit partial errors and unfiltered parent totals.
Legacy --trash-origin and --browse refuse before discovery/mutation until activity, mapping and explicit selection can be verified. Native Trash identity alone does not prove browser inactivity.

bounds.deadlineKind: cooperative between native observations; blocked OS calls can delay cancellation
bounds.scope: per invocation; these are not whole-process RSS or handle caps

regressions: Real protobuf fields ignore cache-name URLs, preserve long partition keys, reject conflicting fields/truncated input.
Legacy blob/leveldb pairs, non-default ports, IPv6 and distinct partition keys.
Independent ordinary fixture walk strictly equals native logical parent/child totals; unknown bucket bytes stay visible.
Corrupt/oversized SQLite metadata and linked external index preserve sizes while declining attribution.
Cancellation, exact profile selection, cache alias deduplication and installation-model reporting.
CLI exact domain filter preserves parent totals, stable schema/keys across locales; legacy mutation flags exit 3 without altering fixture payloads.

hostReport.interpretation: Operational end-to-end time for these browser scopes, not a paired speed benchmark, tail-latency result or whole-system-junk improvement.

independentCrosscheck.causeEvidence: Every differing scope has a content file modified after native output; live browser logs/journals/cache writes continued. No tolerance or expected-value adjustment. Controlled native fixtures use strict accounting equality.
independentCrosscheck.comparisonRun: preceding browser-final-release, same JSON-producing scan logic; human lower-bound rendering subsequently adjusted

yarnOperation.activityMeaning: Content timestamps only, not proof of last Yarn execution. Allocation sums do not account for shared blocks or clone extents.

npxObservation.activityMeaning: Bounded top-level and installed-package manifest observations plus filesystem timestamps; 63 largest-tool installs resolve to 63 versions. No reference or inactivity authority. No npx install removed.
